dogecoin.text: 4️⃣ Dogecoin has surged 21% over the past week, outperforming other memecoins such as $SHIB, $PEPE, and $BONK. This rally comes as whales have acquired over 1 billion $DOGE, and the head of research at Galaxy Digital predicts DOGE could reach $1 in 2025.

3️⃣ Dogecoin rose by 27% over the past week, reaching a two-month high amid a broader market uptrend driven by Bitcoin’s approach toward its ATH above $100k. Ethereum led major crypto assets with a 32% weekly gain, attributed to excitement around the Pectra network upgrade.
